briefdescription.para: Default constructor for Vector3 class. Initializes x, y and z to zero.

detaileddescription.para: Default constructor for the Vector3 class. Initializes a vector with x, y and z components set to zero.

briefdescription.para: Constructs a Vector3 object with the same value for x, y and z.

detaileddescription.para: This constructor initializes all three components of the vector to the given scalar value 'a'. The resulting vector will have equal values in each component (x = a, y = a, z = a).

a
The scalar value used for initialization.
Constructs a Vector3 with equal components.
a
The value to set x, y and z to.

briefdescription.para: Constructs a Vector3 object with the given x, y and z coordinates.

detaileddescription.para:
a
The x-coordinate of the vector.
b
The y-coordinate of the vector.
c
The z-coordinate of the vector.
Constructs a Vector3 object with the given x, y and z coordinates.

parameterdescription.para: The x-coordinate of the vector.
The y-coordinate of the vector.
The z-coordinate of the vector.

briefdescription.para: Constructs a Vector3 object from a Vector2 and a float. The x and y components of the vector are set to the x component of the input Vector2, while z is set to the provided float value.

detaileddescription.para:
a
A Vector2 object representing the x and y components of the new Vector3.
c
A float value representing the z component of the new Vector3.
Constructs a Vector3 object from another Vector2 and a third float value. The x and y components of the new Vector3 are set to be equal to the x component of the input Vector2, while z is set to the provided float value.

parameterdescription.para: A Vector2 object representing the first two dimensions of the vector.
A float value representing the third dimension of the vector.

briefdescription.para: Constructs a Vector3 object from a glm::vec3 vector.

detaileddescription.para: This constructor takes a glm::vec3 vector and assigns its x, y, and z components to the corresponding members of this Vector3 object.

v
The input glm::vec3 vector.
Constructs a Vector3 object from a glm::vec3 vector.
This constructor takes a glm::vec3 vector and assigns its x, y, and z components to the corresponding members of this Vector3 object.

parameterdescription.para: The input glm::vec3 vector.

briefdescription.para: Constructs a Vector3 from another Vector4 by copying the x, y and z values.

parameterdescription.para: The Vector4 to copy data from.

briefdescription.para: This function returns a reference to the element at index 'i' in an array of float numbers.

parameterdescription.para: The index of the element to return.

simplesect.para: A reference to the element at index 'i'. If 'i' is out of bounds, it will throw an exception.

briefdescription.para: This function returns a reference to the element at index 'i' in an array.

parameterdescription.para: The index of the element to return.

simplesect.para: A constant reference to the element at index 'i'. If 'i' is out of bounds, it will throw an exception.

briefdescription.para: Adds two vectors together component-wise.

detaileddescription.para: This function takes another vector as an argument and adds its components to the current vector's components. The result is a new Vector3 object with the sum of the x, y, and z coordinates.

parameterdescription.para: A constant reference to another Vector3 object whose components will be added to this one.

simplesect.para: A new Vector3 object resulting from adding the x, y, and z components of the two vectors together.

briefdescription.para: This function adds the components of a Vector3 to the current vector.

parameterdescription.para: The Vector3 to add to this one.

briefdescription.para: Subtracts another vector from this one and returns the result.

parameterdescription.para: The Vector3 to subtract from this instance.

simplesect.para: A new Vector3 that is the difference between this instance and the provided Vector3.

briefdescription.para: Subtracts another Vector3 from this one.

detaileddescription.para: This function subtracts the x, y and z values of the provided Vector3 from the corresponding values in this Vector3.

parameterdescription.para: The Vector3 to be subtracted from this one.

briefdescription.para: This function returns a new vector that is the result of scaling this vector by a given scalar value.

parameterdescription.para: The value to scale the vector by.

simplesect.para: A new Vector3 object representing the scaled vector.

briefdescription.para: This function scales the x, y and z coordinates of an object by a given scalar value.

parameterdescription.para: The value to scale the coordinates with.

briefdescription.para: Performs division of the vector by a scalar value.

parameterdescription.para: The float value to divide each component of the vector by.

simplesect.para: A new Vector3 where each component is the result of dividing the corresponding component of this vector by the given scalar.

briefdescription.para: Divides the vector's components by a given scalar.

detaileddescription.para: This function divides each of the vector's components (x, y, z) by the provided scalar. It modifies the vector in-place and returns it for convenience.

parameterdescription.para: The value to divide the vector's components by. Must not be zero to avoid division by zero.

simplesect.para: A reference to this Vector3 object after the operation.

briefdescription.para: Normalizes this vector.

detaileddescription.para: This function calculates the magnitude of the vector and divides each component by that magnitude to normalize it. If the magnitude is zero, a zero vector is returned.

A new Vector3 object representing the normalized version of this vector.
Normalizes this vector.

This function calculates the unit vector (a vector with a length of one) in the same direction as the original vector. If the magnitude of the vector is zero, it returns a vector with all components set to zero.

simplesect.para: A new Vector3 object representing the normalized version of this vector.

briefdescription.para: Computes the dot product of this vector with another Vector3 object.

detaileddescription.para: The function takes a constant reference to another Vector3 object and calculates the dot product by multiplying each corresponding component of both vectors together (x*vec.x, y*vec.y, z*vec.z) and summing these products up.

parameterdescription.para: The other Vector3 object to compute the dot product with.

simplesect.para: float Returns the computed dot product as a floating-point number.

briefdescription.para: Computes the cross product of this vector with another one.

detaileddescription.para:
The cross product is a vector that is perpendicular to both given vectors and points in the direction from the first to the second. It has a length equal to the area of the parallelogram with edges being the two input vectors.
vec
The other vector for the cross product operation.
A new Vector3 representing the result of the cross product.

briefdescription.para: Calculates the Euclidean norm (magnitude) of a Vector3 object.

detaileddescription.para: This function calculates the length of the vector from the origin to the point defined by its x, y and z coordinates. It does this by taking the square root of the sum of the squares of differences in each coordinate: sqrtf((x - vec.x)^2 + (y - vec.y)^2 + (z - vec.z)^2).

parameterdescription.para: The Vector3 object for which to calculate the norm.

simplesect.para: A float representing the Euclidean norm of the input vector.

briefdescription.para: Calculates the magnitude of a vector using Euclidean distance formula.

simplesect.para: The magnitude (float) of the vector. If the vector is zero, returns 0.0.

briefdescription.para: Compares this Vector3 with another for equality.

detaileddescription.para: This function compares the x, y and z coordinates of this vector with those of the provided one. It returns true if all three are equal, false otherwise.

parameterdescription.para: The Vector3 to compare against.

simplesect.para: True if the vectors are equal (i.e., their x, y, and z values are all identical), false otherwise.

briefdescription.para: Compares this vector with another for equality.

detaileddescription.para: The comparison is done component-wise, i.e., it checks if the x, y and z components of both vectors are equal.

parameterdescription.para: The Vector3 to compare against.

simplesect.para: True if all components of this vector match those of the provided one; false otherwise.

briefdescription.para: Compares this vector with another for inequality.

detaileddescription.para: This function compares the x, y and z components of this vector with those of the provided vector. It returns true if any of these components are not equal, false otherwise.

parameterdescription.para: The Vector3 to compare against.

simplesect.para: True if any component is different, false otherwise.

briefdescription.para: Converts the object into a string representation.

detaileddescription.para: This function converts the object's x, y and z coordinates into a formatted string. The resulting string includes each coordinate prefixed with "X: ", "Y: ", and "Z: ".

simplesect.para: A std::string containing the formatted coordinates.

briefdescription.para: Converts the object to a glm::vec3 type.

detaileddescription.para:
This operator overload allows for implicit conversion of an object into a glm::vec3 type. It returns a new vector with x, y and z coordinates set as per the current object's values.
A glm::vec3 object containing the x, y and z coordinates of the current object.

briefdescription.para: Converts the current instance of Vector3 to a quaternion.

detaileddescription.para: This function converts the x, y and z values of this vector into a glm::quat object. The resulting quaternion represents the same rotation as this vector.

simplesect.para: A new glm::quat that represents the same rotation as this Vector3.
